verdict.rationale: Convex functions and schema are code files in the local filesystem that the CLI pushes to the deployment as new versions. This implies you can version and review backend logic with your own source control, but the evidence shows no first-party versioning, review, or rollback feature. Missing for 10: any evidence of scheduled jobs or automations specifically, deployment history or diff review, one-step rollback of deployed functions, and independent corroboration.
